name: Infisical project
description: The Infisical project, environment and folder this repository keeps its secrets in.

spec.summary: Which Infisical project, environment and folder this repository reads its secrets from. Chosen once per project; every member uses the same one.

params.label: Infisical instance
params.description: https://app.infisical.com (US cloud), https://eu.infisical.com (EU cloud), or your self-hosted URL, without /api.

params.label: Project slug
params.description: The slug in Project settings (not the display name).

params.label: Environment
params.description: The environment slug this repository's tools read: prod, staging, dev…

params.label: Folder
params.description: The folder inside the environment. / unless the project organises secrets in folders.

steps.title: Create or pick the Infisical project

instructions.*:
1. Open your Infisical instance and sign in with the same account the CLI uses.
2. **Reuse** the project this repository's secrets already live in, or **create** one: *Secrets Management → Add project*. One project per application keeps access and rotation simple; a shared project for everything means everyone who can read one secret can read all of them.
3. In the project, open **Project settings** and copy its **slug** (lowercase, with dashes — not the display name).
4. Check the environment exists (*prod* by default; the slugs are under **Project settings → Environments**).

Fill the fields and press **Check**: it asks Infisical, with your CLI's token, whether the project is visible.
